prose: Riley Ellison has requested a private psychoeducational evaluation for Casey Morgan Ellison to clarify learning and attention concerns that persist despite classroom supports. Specifically, concerns have been raised regarding Casey Morgan Ellison's slow work completion and lost assignments. Riley Ellison hopes to obtain clear recommendations for how to help Casey at home and school. Areas of suspected disability evaluated include Specific Learning Disability and Other Health Impairment.
